info.title: dotnet bee - Bee.NET framework CLI
info.description: Bee.NET framework CLI. Currently ships the `defines` subcommand group for materialising / listing framework default define files (TableSchema / FormSchema / FormLayout / Language / SystemSettings / DatabaseSettings) shipped as embedded resources by Bee.Definition.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the relative paths of all embedded defaults

commands.name: materialize
commands.description: Write embedded framework defaults to a target directory

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite existing files. Default: skip (preserves consumer customisations).

options.name: --filter
options.description:
Only materialize files whose relative path starts with this prefix.
e.g. --filter TableSchema/ to write only schema files.

commands.name: split-menu
commands.description:
Migrate a pre-flattening ProgramSettings.xml into a flat
registry plus MenuSettings.xml

options.name: --path
options.description: The DefinePath directory holding ProgramSettings.xml. Required.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace an existing MenuSettings.xml. Default: refuse.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching any file.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this help text
Run 'dotnet bee help <command>' for command-specific help.
